findings.title: The deity predicate becomes categorical
findings.claim: The repeated deity word recasts the hearers' possessed deity as the category itself, then presents that category for qualification by oneness.
findings.mechanism: The definite construct at 18:110:9:1 is repeated at 18:110:10:1 without the audience suffix, and the second form functions as the predicate before wāḥid, shifting the relation from possession to categorical assertion.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear why the repetition matters: the clause moves from whose deity is named to what the deity is.
findings.containment: This retains the local predicate relation and does not claim that the repetition erases the audience's relation to the deity.

epistemic.reason: The packet's word-analysis support marks the reading narrowed by local predicate grammar.

findings.title: Oneness closes the theology clause
findings.claim: Wāḥid makes divine oneness the predicate of the deity and forms a local bookend with the final exclusion of any partner.
findings.mechanism: Adjective agreement attaches wāḥid directly to ilāhun, while the unity wording is answered at the end by aḥadan under prohibition, joining affirmation of one deity to exclusion of an added associate.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the theology clause already carrying the shape of the closing ban.
findings.containment: The bookend is a local lexical and grammatical relation; it does not collapse the distinct forms or assert that one replaces the other.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the oneness candidate used and supplies direct adjective and bookend evidence.

findings.title: Oneness opens the practical condition
findings.claim: The resultative fa makes the ethical commands a consequence-bearing branch of the oneness clause rather than a detached appendix.
findings.mechanism: The particle attached to man binds the conditional opener to what precedes, so the one-deity declaration flows into a condition governing hope, work, and non-association.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the turn from doctrine to conduct as a grammatical continuation.
findings.containment: Only the local resultative connection is claimed; no wider argumentative architecture is imported.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the particle candidate used and supplies resultative-scope evidence.

findings.title: Whoever opens the condition
findings.claim: Man opens an unrestricted human class: whoever hopes for the meeting falls under the answer, while a residual relative shade remains only as a qualification.
findings.mechanism: The conditional pronoun controls the following protasis and apodosis, and the command that follows confirms that the same open antecedent governs hoping, working, and avoiding association.
findings.reader_payoff: The ethical response is heard as addressed to any qualifying person rather than to a named individual.
findings.containment: The claim keeps the relative nuance visible without treating it as a competing reading or extending the scope beyond the local conditional.

epistemic.reason: The candidate evidence marks the reading narrowed by the conditional-apodosis syntax.

findings.title: Hope is a sustained orientation
findings.claim: Kāna with the imperfect verb frames hoping as a continuing state from which the command pair proceeds.
findings.mechanism: The auxiliary construction gives temporal depth to the state while the imperfect supplies its ongoing orientation, so the perfect form is not read as a separate completed-existence event.
findings.reader_payoff: Hope becomes an orientation that already has to issue in action, not a momentary wish detached from conduct.
findings.containment: The temporal pressure remains subordinate to the local auxiliary construction and does not establish a separate lexical use of the being root.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the candidate narrowed by the periphrastic construction.

findings.title: Hope carries weight
findings.claim: Yarjū names a positive orientation toward the meeting that can carry both desire and fear-tinged weight.
findings.mechanism: The hope-root supplies expectation and the stated meeting supplies its object, allowing the inward orientation to remain hopeful without becoming emotionally weightless.
findings.reader_payoff: The hoped-for meeting gains gravity before the ayah turns that hope into work.
findings.containment: The reading stays with the person's orientation toward the local meeting; it does not turn the lexical pressure into a separate commanded act or a ranked emotional conclusion.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the hope reading narrowed to the local orientation and object.

findings.title: The hope has an event-object
findings.claim: The hoped-for object is a meeting with the Lord, an event of encounter rather than a vague reward or mood.
findings.mechanism: The accusative verbal noun is governed by yarjū, and its construct with rabbihi makes the future relational while retaining the possible direction of the meeting.
findings.reader_payoff: The future becomes a face-to-face event that gives the following work a definite horizon.
findings.containment: The eschatological encounter is retained as the local object, while the construct's person-to-Lord direction remains unresolved rather than selected away.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the event-object reading narrowed by construct ambiguity.

findings.title: Lordship personalizes the meeting
findings.claim: The suffixed Lord is the qualifying person's own Lord in the hoped encounter, and the same personal relation is available again in the worship phrase.
findings.mechanism: The first rabbihi is governed by liqāʾa and its suffix reaches back to man; the repeated form later carries the same relational Lordship into worship.
findings.reader_payoff: The encounter is not an abstract meeting with divinity but a relation addressed to each person.
findings.containment: The claim is limited to the local construct, suffix, and repetition; it does not resolve every possible semantic facet of the Lordship root.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the personal-Lordship reading narrowed by the construct and suffix.

findings.title: Hope turns into command
findings.claim: The answer particle turns hope for the meeting immediately into a required response.
findings.mechanism: The second fa marks the apodosis and attaches directly to the first jussive command, leaving no grammatical pause between expected encounter and action.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hope is given a verb to do before it is allowed to remain an abstraction.
findings.containment: Only the local conditional hinge is claimed; the finding does not rank action above hope or replace the future orientation.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the answer-particle candidate used and supplies direct apodosis evidence.

findings.title: The command stays inside whoever
findings.claim: The command particle keeps the work imperative inside the third-person whoever frame.
findings.mechanism: Lām al-amr governs the following jussive verb, so the response remains let whoever hopes work rather than changing into direct address.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can follow the universal condition all the way into its required action.
findings.containment: The finding concerns the command's grammatical frame and does not deny the rhetorical force of hearing the command personally.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks both command-particle rows used and directly ties them to the whoever frame.

findings.title: The finale is commanded speech
findings.claim: Qul frames the ayah as a commanded public proclamation, with the human speaker nested inside a higher speech frame.
findings.mechanism: The second-person imperative introduces the declaration, while the following first-person and recipient forms remain inside that command-to-speak frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The self-description is heard as transmitted speech rather than private reflection.
findings.containment: The claim stays with the opening imperative and its local deictic frame; it does not infer a broader speech theory.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the commanded-speech candidate used and supplies imperative morphology and frame evidence.

findings.title: Work is the positive response
findings.claim: The jussive makes deliberate work the positive response assigned to the person inside the hope-condition.
findings.mechanism: The command particle governs yaʿmal, and the individual antecedent man supplies the agent, while the following cognate object gives the action a produced result.
findings.reader_payoff: The response to hoped encounter becomes personally enacted work rather than a merely inward sentiment.
findings.containment: The claim is about commanded agency in this clause and does not reduce every possible meaning of the work root to one occupational sense.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the work candidate used and directly supports jussive agency.

findings.title: The deed makes work concrete
findings.claim: The cognate object turns the command to work into a concrete deed whose kind remains open for qualification.
findings.mechanism: ʿAmalan repeats the root of yaʿmal as its accusative cognate object, intensifying the action and leaving ṣāliḥan to specify the deed's required quality.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a deed-output forming in the grammar rather than an unbounded instruction to be active.
findings.containment: The finding preserves the indefinite openness of the deed and does not supply a hidden inventory of acceptable acts.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the cognate-object candidate used and supplies direct case and concord evidence.

findings.title: Quality belongs to the deed
findings.claim: Ṣāliḥan qualifies the deed itself as sound, fitting, and reparative rather than directly naming the worker or praising activity in the abstract.
findings.mechanism: The active participle agrees with ʿamalan, and the local root pressure lets the deed be tested for fitness and repair while the following prohibition supplies a paired boundary.
findings.reader_payoff: The command asks for work whose own quality can be examined, not merely work of any kind.
findings.containment: The lexical field remains qualified by the local agreement; no single moral or functional gloss is declared the only possible rendering.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the soundness reading narrowed to the deed's agreement and local form.

findings.title: The two commands form one answer
findings.claim: The conjunction keeps righteous work and non-association together as coequal parts of the answer to the condition.
findings.mechanism: Wa joins the positive jussive and the prohibition within the same answer scope, so the second command is not a later aside detached from the first.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader receives construction and refusal as one paired response to hoped encounter.
findings.containment: The coordination does not collapse the two commands into one act or rank them; it only preserves their shared scope.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the coordination candidate used and supplies direct joining evidence.

findings.title: Prohibition reaches anyone
findings.claim: The final clause is a binding prohibition whose scope reaches the indefinite object and excludes any possible associate.
findings.mechanism: Lā directly governs yushrik, and its prohibitive scope extends through the worship complement to aḥadan, turning the closing phrase into total exclusion rather than description.
findings.reader_payoff: The last clause is heard as an active ban with no personal exception.
findings.containment: The finding states the scope of the local prohibition without adding a separate legal taxonomy or resolving other possible root imagery.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the prohibitive-scope candidate used and supplies direct government and scope evidence.

findings.title: Association is active partner-making
findings.claim: Yushrik presents association as an active introduction or making of a partner inside worship, and the prohibition blocks that action.
findings.mechanism: Form IV supplies the causative partner-making relation while prohibitive lā governs the jussive; the supplied variant voice and wider snare imagery remain qualifications around the canonical frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing ban addresses the act of inserting another participant into worship, not a passive condition of sharing.
findings.containment: The canonical third-person conditional frame remains intact; the variant direct-address reading is retained as source qualification, not substituted for it.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the active partner-making reading narrowed by the local form and prohibition.

findings.title: The ban is located inside worship
findings.claim: Bi locates the prohibited association specifically inside the worship relation before the final object names the excluded associate.
findings.mechanism: The bound preposition attaches the worship phrase to yushrik and marks ʿibādati rabbihi as the domain in which association is forbidden.
findings.reader_payoff: The scope of the ban becomes visible before the grammar reaches its final anyone-word.
findings.containment: The finding concerns the complement and domain of the local verb; it does not generalize the prohibition to every kind of association outside this phrase.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the preposition candidate used and supplies direct attachment evidence.

findings.title: Worship names the service domain
findings.claim: ʿIbādati names a Lord-directed service and worship relation whose integrity the prohibition protects.
findings.mechanism: The verbal noun is in construct with rabbihi and is governed through the prepositional complement, so the root's service and servitude pressure is narrowed to the act-domain of worship here.

findings.title: The same Lord is awaited and served
findings.claim: The repeated suffixed Lord links the one hoped for in the encounter clause to the one whose worship must remain undivided.
findings.mechanism: The second rabbihi is governed by ʿibādati and repeats the earlier form with the same third-person suffix, carrying personal Lordship from future meeting into present service.
findings.reader_payoff: The ethical command is tied to the same personal relation that gave the hope its object.
findings.containment: The finding preserves the local repetition and relational suffix without claiming that every Lordship facet has the same force here.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the Lordship echo narrowed to the worship construct and repeated form.

findings.title: The final word seals non-association
findings.claim: Aḥadan is the indefinite object under prohibition, so the ayah closes by excluding anyone at all from being admitted as a partner.
findings.mechanism: The final word is governed by yushrik under lā, and its unity-field echo with wāḥid turns one deity in the theology clause into no additional person in worship.
findings.reader_payoff: The final grammatical landing gives the prohibition its exhaustive reach.
findings.containment: The claim stays with the local case, negation, and bookend; it does not turn final position into a separate proof beyond the supplied grammar.

findings.title: The opening restricts identity
findings.claim: Innamā restricts the opening self-description to the human-likeness clause before the revelation clause begins.
findings.mechanism: The fused particle takes scope over the nominal identity claim and closes before yuḥā, placing human limitation first and received distinction second.
findings.reader_payoff: The messenger's humanity is heard as an explicit boundary rather than a neutral description.
findings.containment: The scope is local to the opening identity clause; it does not erase the revelation clause that follows or assert a broader restriction.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the restrictive-identity reading narrowed to the local clause.

findings.title: The restriction bears on the speaker
findings.claim: The independent first-person pronoun makes the restricted identity visibly about the speaking self.
findings.mechanism: Anā anchors basharun as the predicate of the commanded speaker, so self-limitation is carried by the explicit subject rather than by an abstract statement about messengers.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears a person saying what he is permitted to claim about himself.
findings.containment: The finding remains at the pronoun and nominal-clause relation and does not add a separate theory of prophetic identity.

findings.title: Humanity is embodied
findings.claim: Basharun classifies the speaker as an embodied human within the human class before revelation distinguishes his reception.
findings.mechanism: The indefinite nominative predicate completes anā, and its attachment to mithlukum fixes the messenger inside the human category rather than merely describing a social or cognitive status.
findings.reader_payoff: The revelation that follows arrives to a human body and person, not to an already elevated category.
findings.containment: The local predicate selects human embodiment; the root's other skin, tidings, and visible-affect branches are not activated here.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the embodied-human reading narrowed by the nominal predicate and comparison phrase.

findings.title: Likeness is addressed to the hearers
findings.claim: Mithlukum makes the speaker categorically like the addressed hearers, so revelation differentiates reception only after human parity is stated.
findings.mechanism: The construct phrase qualifies basharun and the second-person plural suffix directs the comparison to the audience, binding likeness to the local human predicate.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader is included in the comparison before being asked to notice the asymmetry of revelation.
findings.containment: The claim remains with human parity in this phrase; wider example and measure associations are retained as qualification, not as additional local senses.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the likeness reading narrowed by attachment and suffix evidence.

findings.title: Revelation is received
findings.claim: Yuḥā presents revelation as incoming communication received by the human speaker without undoing the preceding human limitation.
findings.mechanism: The passive Form IV leaves the revealer implicit and foregrounds the affected recipient; the placement after innamā anā basharun preserves limitation while naming the received distinction.
findings.reader_payoff: The messenger's difference appears as reception rather than self-generated elevation.
findings.containment: The local passive reception is retained; broader signaling, writing, and speed associations remain lexical pressure rather than activated readings.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the received-revelation reading narrowed to passive form and local sequence.

findings.title: The speaker is the endpoint
findings.claim: Ilayya makes the speaker the endpoint and recipient toward whom the passive revelation arrives.
findings.mechanism: The directional preposition plus first-person suffix completes yuḥā as an incoming route to the speaker rather than an act generated by him.
findings.reader_payoff: The grammar gives revelation a direction and places the speaker at its receiving end.
findings.containment: The finding concerns the complement relation only and does not infer an unprovided description of the revealer.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the revelation-endpoint candidate used and supplies direct complement evidence.

findings.title: The revealed content is restricted

findings.mechanism: The content-introducing restrictive particle opens ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun as the received proposition, then the resultative conditional carries that restriction into conduct.
findings.reader_payoff: The ayah moves from who receives revelation to the bounded content that is received.
findings.containment: The finding preserves the local nested restriction and does not claim that the content clause exhausts every possible theological statement outside this ayah.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the restricted-content candidate used and supplies nested-clause evidence.

findings.title: The hearers' deity is reclassified

findings.mechanism: The definite construct ties the first deity word to the hearers, while the following indefinite predicate and adjective redirect that known object of devotion into a singular category.
findings.reader_payoff: The doctrine addresses the hearers' own object of devotion before stating its singularity.
findings.containment: The reading stays with the local subject-predicate grammar; it does not turn the broader root field into a second competing denotation.

epistemic.reason: The packet marks the hearers'-deity reading narrowed by subject-predicate grammar and suffix.

findings.title: The speaker is a human receiver
findings.claim: The ayah presents the speaker as humanly equal to the hearers while receiving and voicing a hidden message.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace joins commanded saying, human classification, likeness to the audience, and passive incoming revelation; sameness blocks elevation while reception differentiates access and public speech transmits what arrives.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold human parity and asymmetrical reception together in the same speaking figure.
findings.containment: This is an attributed HFT synthesis over the exact focus ayah; it does not invent a branch gloss beyond the supplied registry or resolve questions outside the local trace.

findings.mechanism: The HFT trace connects the worshipped object, unpartnered divine unity, active participation, submissive worship, and exhaustive negation; the one divine addressee makes the worship relation non-shareable and the final indefinite closes exceptions.
findings.reader_payoff: Monotheism becomes a structure of who may occupy the worship relation, not only a statement of number.
findings.containment: This is an attributed HFT synthesis over the focus ayah; it does not add an unprovided branch gloss or claim that all forms of association outside worship are addressed here.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: No second participant may be introduced into the worship relation.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace keeps the branch at relational partnership and does not generalize it to every non-devotional sharing.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Eylem, sıradan itaati aşan bir boyun eğme ve alçalma tutumu içerir.
branch_activations.carrier: Submissive worship names the relation that must remain undivided.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The partner-making verb and the repeated Lord phrase specify the relation's object and threatened division.
branch_activations.activation: The worship noun contacts the ban and its Lord complement, making submission the domain in which partnership is excluded.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The allegiance being protected is devotional submission to the Lord.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not invoke legal servitude or every non-religious use of the root.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Olumsuzluk altında konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişiler türünün tamamını kapsar.
branch_activations.carrier: Exhaustive negation removes every possible personal exception.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The prohibitive negation and partner-making verb supply the negative scope.
branch_activations.activation: The indefinite object contacts the prohibition after the worship domain is named, closing the relation against any additional person.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The allegiance structure leaves no personal exception for a partner.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not transfer this negative branch to unrelated uses of the word outside the local prohibition.

findings.title: Encounter gives work its fit
findings.claim: Whoever lives toward encounter is directed to make present labor fit the Lord's completing relation and keep its worshipal direction unshared.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace joins hope, encounter, Lordship as nurture and completion, intentional work, and fitness; the anticipated meeting supplies an endpoint against which present work is tested.
findings.reader_payoff: Good work becomes a response shaped by a future relation, not merely a quantity of activity or a wish for reward.
findings.containment: This is an attributed HFT synthesis over the focus ayah; it preserves the local command and does not replace ordinary work, hope, or worship readings with an unbounded system.

epistemic.reason: The exact anchor and trace are supplied, but the HFT roles remain attributed under the packet qualification.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Gönül, gerçekleşmesi sevindirici olacak bir sonuca olumlu biçimde yönelir.
branch_activations.carrier: The heart's projection toward what is hoped for gives present action a future pull.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The meeting verbal noun supplies the concrete hoped-for endpoint.
branch_activations.activation: Hope contacts the event-object, so the future meeting becomes the orientation from which action is read.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Present work is pulled forward by an anticipated encounter.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not reduce hope to a single emotional state or claim a separate reward vocabulary.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İki kişi veya şey karşı karşıya gelir ya da biri ötekiyle rastlaşır.
branch_activations.carrier: Two parties coming into encounter supplies the action's terminal horizon.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Hope supplies the orientation and the Lord construct supplies the relational other.
branch_activations.activation: The meeting noun contacts both the hopeful verb and the personal Lord phrase, giving work a face-to-face horizon.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The hoped future is an encounter that can govern present conduct.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not decide among every lexical facet of meeting or its construct direction.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
branch_activations.carrier: Repair, nurture, and completion define the relation to which the work must answer.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The commanded work and worship construct give the Lord relation its ethical contact points.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated Lord forms contact the work command and worship phrase, allowing Lordship to be heard as a completing relation that receives the work.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Work is fitted to the Lord's completing relation and its worshipal direction.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not claim that every Lordship or family-related branch is active.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: Intentional doing supplies the present operation shaped by that horizon.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Hope supplies the future pull and ṣāliḥan supplies the criterion applied to the deed.
branch_activations.activation: The work verb and cognate object contact the hope and quality words, turning intentional doing into present labor assessed by its endpoint.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The response is deliberate work whose form can answer the hoped meeting.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not narrow all work to employment or a single task type.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey ile yöneldiği kişi arasında uygunluk ve uyma ilişkisi bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: Fitness and suitability make ṣāliḥ a relational criterion, not a decorative label.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The deed and its Lord-directed relation supply the thing and person-facing contact for suitability.
branch_activations.activation: The quality participle contacts the commanded deed and the Lord relation, making the work fit the relation it is meant to answer.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The deed is evaluated for fitting soundness in relation to the hoped Lord.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not claim that the suitability branch replaces the ordinary soundness reading.

friction_notes: The packet supplies no selected non-focus context units and no connections, so all retained findings remain focus-local.

The three HFT traces have complete focus anchors but legacy_unbound provenance; their segmentation, roles, and branch applications remain attributed, and the exact Arabic anchor verifies surface contact only.
